_comment: Reference copy of the least-privilege policies attached via SAM's Policies: blocks in template.yaml. Kept here so the permission set is reviewable without reading CloudFormation. Not deployed directly.
notes: bedrock:InvokeModel currently must be scoped to '*' or to foundation-model ARNs (not KB ARNs) for on-demand models per AWS documentation — cannot be narrowed to the specific Knowledge Base ARN.
S3 access IS scoped to the specific bucket prefix pattern rather than '*'.
Neither Lambda has any IAM permissions beyond what's listed here — no wildcard admin access.
